assertion: The Realtor.com analysis noted that, as recently as 2019, it took the typical household about 5.7 years to save for a 10% down payment, while that timeline has nearly doubled to 10½ years, which is more than triple the time it took in the 1980s.
inaccuracy: The piece says higher home prices and mortgage rates drove the time to save up; the median price-to-income ratio rose only 4.66 to 4.75 from 2019 to 2025, and mortgage rates do not enter a down-payment calculation. The warehouse's personal saving rate fell from 7.3% (2019) to 4.5% (2026), which accounts for the near-doubling.
